## XpmBuildConfigurations.engine property

The Liquid templating engine for variable substitution.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly engine: XpmLiquidEngine;
```

## Remarks

This engine instance is shared across all build configurations and configured with custom filters for platform detection, path manipulation, and xpm-specific operations. It processes templates in configuration names, matrix parameters, properties, dependencies, and actions, ensuring consistent template evaluation throughout the configuration lifecycle.
